title: Gouache demo today on ConcertWindow
content: Here's the gouache landscape I painted "in the wild" today during the hour-long livewebcast on ConcertWindow. Thanks to the 150 of you who joined in from as far as Australia, Russia, Argentina and all over the USA!Len Nicholas asked the type of sketchbook I was using.
